investigation_notes.Scriptblock: Get-ChildItem C:\Users -Recurse -Include *.kdbx,*.pst,*.docx -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName,Length | Export-Csv C:\ProgramData\user_cache.csv -NoTypeInformation
investigation_notes.Description: A PowerShell command was executed that recursively searches all user directories for .kdbx, .pst, and .docx files and exports the results to C:\ProgramData\user_cache.csv. The targeted file types are sensitive and exporting to a shared system location is consistent with local staging of collected data, which is atypical for routine administrative tasks on a financial server. There is no initiating process, file path, or prior sightings in the environment to support a benign explanation, so the activity is assessed as a potential data collection attempt and warrants elevated attention.
